why_realistic: A max() introduced as protection ('a card good enough to be scored deserves at least the archived-tier credit') sits at 0.6 while ordinary final_score values approach it from below, so the entire low end of the only graded reward the bandit has collapses to one flat value and a score of 20 teaches the arm exactly what a score of 55 does. Same shape as the real protective floor that the data always approached from below.
oracle:
"""The score-derived reward is the bandit's only GRADED signal (the flag paths are three fixed
constants). It has to stay strictly monotone in final_score, so a weak card teaches its arm less
than a strong one and less than an outright archived card.

A floor placed at the archived reward is approached from below by every ordinary score, which turns
the graded signal into a flat constant across the whole low end. These assert returned rewards."""
import bandit

CFG = {"scoring": {"bandit": {"prior_alpha": 1.0, "prior_beta": 1.0,
                              "explore_weight_lo": 0.5, "explore_weight_hi": 1.5,
                              "reward_pushed": 1.0, "reward_archived": 0.6,
                              "reward_blocked": 0.0}}}


def test_the_low_end_of_the_reward_still_discriminates():
    r20 = bandit.outcome_reward({"final_score": 20}, CFG)
    r40 = bandit.outcome_reward({"final_score": 40}, CFG)
    r55 = bandit.outcome_reward({"final_score": 55}, CFG)
    assert r20 < r40 < r55, (r20, r40, r55)


def test_a_weak_card_teaches_less_than_an_archived_one():
    weak = bandit.outcome_reward({"final_score": 20}, CFG)
    archived = bandit.outcome_reward({"archived": True}, CFG)
    strong = bandit.outcome_reward({"final_score": 90}, CFG)
    assert weak < archived < strong, (weak, archived, strong)


def test_the_reward_is_still_bounded_and_ordered_on_the_flag_paths():
    for fs in (-10, 0, 50, 120):
        r = bandit.outcome_reward({"final_score": fs}, CFG)
        assert 0.0 <= r <= 1.0, (fs, r)
    assert (bandit.outcome_reward({"pushed": True}, CFG)
            > bandit.outcome_reward({"archived": True}, CFG)
            > bandit.outcome_reward({"blocked": True}, CFG))
